kpis.signal: Segment IWM (Investment & Wealth Mgmt), reprise lente post 2022

kpis.description_en: AUM Investment & Wealth Management segment. FY25 $2.2T (+10%), more volatile than custody but key for premium pricing. Gradual recovery from 2022 trough ($1.8T).

kpis.signal: JV Canada avec CIBC, complément Asset Servicing

kpis.description_en: CIBC Mellon Trust Company joint venture AUC/A (50/50 with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce). Q1 2025 $1.9T vs $1.7T Q1 2024. BNY's Canadian Asset Servicing arm.

kpis.description_fr: Commissions de services investissement (custody, asset servicing, clearance, Pershing, treasury services). Q1 2025 2 383 M$ (+5.4% YoY). Split Q1 2025 : Securities Services 1 311 M$ + Market & Wealth Services 1 065 M$.
kpis.description_en: Investment services fees (custody, asset servicing, clearance, Pershing, treasury services). Q1 2025 $2,383M (+5.4% YoY). Q1 2025 split: Securities Services $1,311M + Market & Wealth Services $1,065M.

kpis.signal: Capital solide, marge confort vs minimum réglementaire ~8%
kpis.description_fr: Ratio Common Equity Tier 1 sous l'approche Standardisée (= ratio binding pour BNY). Q1 2025 11.5% vs 11.2% Q1 2024. Marge confortable vs minimum réglementaire ~8% (avec buffers G-SIB + SCB).
kpis.description_en: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio under Standardized Approach (= binding ratio for BNY). Q1 2025 11.5% vs 11.2% Q1 2024. Comfortable margin vs ~8% regulatory minimum (with G-SIB + SCB buffers).

kpis_story.description_fr: Modernization technologique massive 2023-2026 : retraite legacy platforms, plateforme unifiée Eagle pour custody + accounting. Investment $1Md+, payback expected via efficiency 2027+.
